name: Oni Quake

card.plain: Slam the club into the ground; the shock hits low.
Lv 1 → Lv 2: Oni Quake recovers 4 frames faster, so a blocked slam costs less.

2.notes: Proposed (open question, A4). Recovery is the tail of the clip (frames 32-56, the eased-out settle), so the step needs no change to the startup the clip shows. Chosen for the Oni's rushdown identity: a 27-frame tell is read by the player, and the step makes the blocked slam less of a free punish rather than making it faster to see coming. Startup -4 was rejected: the hit would land before the club does (F2). Overlap to decide: Brute Recovery already takes 4 recovery frames off on block.

card.plain: A second quake cracks the ground where the first struck.
card.frames: 27 / 4 / 25 frames, 90 damage, hits low, second quake 30 frames after the first
